parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Assess the relationship between digital technology and creativity in your production work.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate one of your productions in relation to the concept of narrative. 
Section B: Contemporary media issues
Answer one question from Section B.
You should refer to at least two different media and support your answer with reference to contemporary
examples.
Contemporary media regulation

text: ‘Media regulation must adapt to technological change.’ How far do you agree with this view? [50]
OR
To what extent can today’s media regulation be the same as that of the past? [50]
Global media
Assess the arguments for and against global media in relation to representation. [50]
OR
‘The media are increasingly global.’ Discuss this view. [50]
Media and collective identity
How far do contemporary media offer a diversity of representations of particular groups? [50]
OR
To what extent do people today now have the power to represent themselves? [50]
Media in the online age
‘Media institutions have failed to adapt to the challenges and opportunities of online media.’ How
far do you agree with this view? [50]
OR
To what extent has the online age changed the behaviours of audiences? [50]
Postmodern media
‘Postmodernism is so much more than intertextuality.’ To what extent do you agree with this view?
OR
How far do audiences operate differently in a postmodern world? [50]
